control.name: CONTROL — accept a checksums line of any shape (a malformed line is no longer refused)

mutations.name: read the checksums asset truncated (an over-bound checksums.txt is parsed as its first maxAssetBytes bytes)
readCapped reads only up to the bound (an over-bound answer is handed back as its first limit bytes, never refused)
read the release answer uncapped (a release past the bound is decoded)
read a release-list page uncapped (a page past the bound is decoded)
